run.legacyQt: cmake --build build-native-relocated --target core_tests ui_tests allocation_tests --parallel 2; ctest --test-dir build-native-relocated --output-on-failure --parallel 2
run.sprayConsumer: npm --prefix web-app run test:spray-contract (local production-assets server required)
run.producer: See contracts-README.md; regeneration writes a separate output and must not replace stored expectations automatically.

stored-rgba.mandatory: Existing decoded/stored straight RGBA and alpha0 hidden RGB, dimensions and metadata are exact where the named raw fixture applies. Mask/outside-source bytes are exact.
stored-rgba.allowance: No blanket pixel tolerance. Decoder color conversion/legacy premultiplication is separately declared.

qt-premultiplied.mandatory: Alpha exact; Qt reference channel equivalence uses round(channel*alpha/255). Named geometry masks/row spans remain exact.
qt-premultiplied.allowance: Qt pixelColor unpremultiplication need not equal newly stored straight RGB; this does not relax source-file raw preservation.

raster-local.mandatory: Named input bounds, geometry/interior/color/alpha, commit count and state behavior; exact masks remain exact when explicitly referenced.
raster-local.allowance: QPainter versus Canvas2D boundary antialiasing/soft-dab rasterization may differ under the recorded per-case policy. No permission for missing geometry, broader dirty regions or hidden data changes.

text-local.mandatory: Text value/preedit/clip/viewport/alpha and pending ownership; existing rasterized text pixels are stored pixels.
text-local.allowance: New glyph rasterization depends on installed font/OS/backend. Cross-OS glyph identity is not a baseline requirement; OS IME acceptance remains separate.

state-exact.mandatory: Preserve the state fields actually observed by each owner: engine revision/saved IDs in engine tests, public dirty/saved/pending and replayed Redo in public tests. Files/candidates install only on success.
state-exact.allowance: Public UI assertions do not claim private numeric revision observations or actual OS delivery.
